title: Chapter 101 Do You Know Who I Am?
content:
Chapter 101 Do You Know Who I Am?

Challenge!

Suddenly, countless dragons were filled with blood.

Their eyes towards Ao Qing became even more fiery.

"Hahaha, Ao Cheng, you old thing, I have tolerated you for a long time, let me see how my son will deal with you!"

At this time, Ao Lie shouted excitedly.

This is what it means for a father to rely on his son's power.

Ao Cheng looked at Ao Lie's arrogant expression, then looked at Ao Qing's cold eyes and the sarcastic and cold expressions of the surrounding tribesmen.

At this moment, he finally knew that he had already been in a state of decline.

He regretted.

Why didn't he kill Ao Qing directly at the beginning.

Otherwise, there would not be such an embarrassing situation now.

Facing Ao Qing's challenge, Ao Cheng was afraid.

Although he didn't know how strong Ao Qing was now, he could understand that he was definitely not his opponent after feeling the terrifying pressure a little bit.

Especially Ao Qing's extra fifth claw, which only existed in the legend of the dragon clan.

But now it appeared on Ao Qing.

Seeing that Ao Cheng did not react, Ao Lie sneered: "Ao Cheng, you are not scared, are you?"

The other dragons looked at Ao Cheng with more irony.

Seeing this, Ao Cheng snorted and said: "Okay, come on, let you, the younger generation, see what real power is!"

At this moment, Ao Cheng had obviously lost his mind.

Ao Qing had no mercy on Ao Cheng.

Boom!

Accompanied by Ao Qing's dragon tail swing, Ao Cheng was blown away without any suspense.

The gap in strength was too great.

The smoke dissipated, leaving only Ao Cheng foaming at the mouth and lying on the ground.

Instant kill!

It was expected.

But at this time, the dragon clan members were dazed.

Lord Longzi is so strong!

Looking at Ao Cheng who had lost consciousness at this time, Ao Qing was silent.

He was hesitating about how to deal with Ao Cheng.

At this moment, Ao Lie suddenly said, "Ah Qing, kill him!"

Hearing this, Ao Qing looked at his father.

Ao Lie continued, "The winner is the king and the loser is the bandit. If you lose, do you think he will let you go?"

After this, Ao Qing was stunned.

On the side, countless dragon clan members lowered their heads.

They no longer needed to watch what happened next.

Swish!

With the attack of Ao Qing, a powerful master of the Divine Lord Realm, dragon blood immediately sprayed across the sky.

The famous dragon clan ancestor Ao Cheng fell at this point.

In the end, Ao Qing led the entire Wanling Realm dragon clan into the deserted city without any suspense.

But it was only the deserted city of the Wanling Realm.

If you want to enter a higher level deserted city, you can only rely on the dragon clan's own ability.

......

"Master Chief, I have something to report!"

In the main residence of the desert guards.

A desert guard knelt on one knee in the courtyard and said respectfully.

It turned out that he was the guard who was waiting by the time tunnel.

A moment later, a voice came from the house.

"Come in."

Hearing this, he trembled all over, then took a deep breath and slowly stepped in.

Creak.

The door opened, and he knelt down directly in front of A Wei who was sitting at the table.

"I greet the leader."

"Get up."

"Thank you, leader."

Pah!

A Wei put down the documents in his hand, looked up at the guard, and said in a calm voice: "What happened?"

"Leader, a casino appeared in the deserted city of Wanlingjie."

As soon as these words came out, A Wei stood up immediately.

"What did you say?"

A Wei frowned and said in a deep voice.

Suddenly, the guard of the wilderness looked tense and said in a trembling voice: "There is a casino in the wilderness city, and, and..."

"And what?"

"Master leader, the owner of the casino is not ordinary, even our guards of the wilderness don't take him seriously."

Hearing this, A Wei laughed immediately.

But the smile was very cold.

Even the guards of the wilderness don't take him seriously?

A Wei looked at Zhan Tian who was standing aside.

This knife was given by Lu Daosheng in the past, in order to make him a judge.

And now, such a bold and reckless person appeared in the wilderness city.

Disregarding the rules.

If he didn't kill the other party, how could he face the city lord.

"Come here!"

Soon, countless terrifying auras surged from the wilderness city.

A large number of guards of the wilderness went in one direction.

At the same time, in the wilderness city of the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

Somewhere in the outer city, in a quiet alley.

At this moment, countless guards have gathered here, guarding the place to the death.

Not even a fly can fly out.

"Sir, um, can I leave?"

The young man said in a trembling voice.

I thought that as long as I reported this place, everything would be fine, but now I can't even leave.

Not long after the guard entered the time-space tunnel to report, a large number of guards rushed to the time-space tunnel and asked him to lead the way to the casino he mentioned.

Next, only the leader of the guards arrived.

Because according to the investigation, the owner of this casino seems to be related to a big shot in the inner city.

This makes them have to be cautious.

At this time, underground in the alley.

There is an extremely huge underground space here.

The sound of lively cheers continued to sound, forming a strong contrast with the tranquility above the ground.

"Hahaha, come on, give money, give money!"

A big-bellied man was smiling so much that his eyes were gone. It was obvious that he had won a lot.

At this time, a figure suddenly appeared beside the man and said in a deep voice: "Young Master Zhang, it's bad. A large number of wild guards appeared outside. We have been discovered."

Hearing this, the man called Young Master Zhang was slightly stunned and frowned and said: "Wild guards, what's going on? Don't they know that I am from the Zhang family?"

This place was discovered by the wild guards a long time ago.

But when the other party learned of his identity, he was polite to him. In the end, after a lot of talking, the other party did not report the matter.

After all, their Zhang family is the top family in the city.

More importantly, the Zhang family is the elder of the wild city, and I don't know how powerful it is.

Even the city lord was polite to their Zhang family. He was really not afraid of the mere wild guards.

"Go out and tell them that I am Zhang Guangyao of the Zhang family. Let them go back. My father will visit them in person in two days."

Zhang Guangyao waved his hand casually.

However, as soon as the words fell, a cold voice suddenly sounded.

"I think it's not necessary."

Suddenly, countless powerful auras suddenly descended.

At the entrance, hundreds of Huangwei walked slowly towards here.

The long sword on the waist of the leader was faintly flashing, and the aura revealed shocked everyone.

In an instant, the entire underground casino was completely quiet.

Huangwei!

Although they heard that the owner here was not afraid of Huangwei, they dared to come here to play.

But it was only the owner here who was not afraid.

It doesn't mean that they were not afraid.

Seeing Huangwei, everyone present was shocked.

Seeing so many people in this casino, Awei's face suddenly became gloomy.

"Catch them all!"

"Slow!"

As soon as Awei finished speaking, a voice sounded.

Zhang Guangyao looked at Awei, frowned slightly and said: "Do you know who I am?"

Hearing this, Awei's face was gloomy and said: "Then do you know who I am?!"
